reading_rule: Reading 1 once storedcopy.py shows an OAI-SearchBot fetch after second_push.at for a page; pages without one are held out. Same plain prompt, 2 chats per page, groups interleaved: visibility_scan.py --questions growth/focus/ab-harvest-A.json / ab-harvest-B.json. Reading 2 one week later. Call: A ahead of B by >= 20 points on cited-when-retrieved, reading 2.

second_push.what: Group A and the new pages: pick line and table show the brand's own price beside the price through our link with its test date; no code text where the link applies it. 36 more products' links pre-apply their code (69 of 77). Group B pages change only where a product's link now pre-applies (wording of their code lines).

third_push.reading_rule: Reading 2 per A page once storedcopy.py shows an OAI-SearchBot fetch after third_push.at; B pages read in the same window. 2 plain chats per page (visibility_scan.py, no --pace), groups interleaved, against the 11-08 baselines. Call unchanged: A ahead of B by >= 20 points on cited-when-retrieved. Buy-link handover (/go/ or dealectric-20 Amazon link) is scored on the 13 buy_compare pages only. Reading 2 measures second and third push together.
